FN-CXAKCQQ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 271
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/11/2026
Senate Bill 271 as introduced proposes a constitutional amendment, which if ratified, would
provide for the election of a Lieutenant Governor at the next general election if a vacancy occurs
in the office of the Lieutenant Governor more than sixty-days prior to the general election.
Additionally, this bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the
State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 271
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/27/2026
Senate Bill 271 as passed by the Senate proposes a constitutional amendment, which if ratified,
would provide for the election of a Lieutenant Governor at the next general election if a vacancy
occurs in the office of the Lieutenant Governor more than sixty-days prior to the general
election.
Additionally, this bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the
State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027.
